message_content: {"issues":[{"claim_span_id":"claim-run-fb524bd6-a098-422b-bd6c-392c591b3d5f-1","status":"conflict","nature":"confirmed_conflict","category":"object_state","severity":"high","explanation":"同一时刻，North Glass 气动载具的阀门盖未锁紧，因此它不可能处于可发运状态。","reasoning":"证据 span-5 明确记载同一 10点 该载具压力表读数为四巴，但阀门盖整分钟保持松开且未锁紧；记忆 north_glass-4 的静态规则规定，载具只有在压力表四巴且阀门盖锁紧时才可发运。当前草稿却断言同一 10点 该载具已可发运。两条前提与当前断言在同一对象、同一时刻下无法共存，构成直接矛盾。","temporal_basis":{"claim_anchor":"At 10点 on the same day","evidence_anchor":"At 10点 on the same day","relation":"explicit_overlap"},"evidence":[{"chapter_id":"fixture-chapter-north_glass-5","span_id":"fixture-span-north_glass-5","relation":"contradicts","sufficiency":"sufficient","related_memory_ids":["fixture-memory-north_glass-5"]},{"chapter_id":"fixture-chapter-north_glass-4","span_id":"fixture-span-north_glass-4","relation":"context","sufficiency":"sufficient","related_memory_ids":["fixture-memory-north_glass-4"]}],"evidence_chain":[{"span_id":"fixture-span-north_glass-5","role":"prior_state"},{"span_id":"fixture-span-north_glass-4","role":"current_context"}],"suggested_revision":{"before":"At 10点 on the same day, the North Glass pneumatic carrier was ready for dispatch.","after":"At 10点 on the same day, the North Glass pneumatic carrier was not ready for dispatch: its gauge read four bars, but its valve cap remained loose and not locked."},"available_actions":["edit","apply_suggestion","keep_intentional","false_positive"]}],"claim_verdicts":[{"claim_span_id":"claim-run-fb524bd6-a098-422b-bd6c-392c591b3d5f-1","verdict":"reviewed_issue","basis":"同一 10点 的载具状态与静态发运规则共同证明：阀门盖未锁紧时载具不可发运，与草稿断言直接冲突。"}]}
